newsitem.title: CHINA: Price Waterhouse to invest $100 mln in China.
newsitem.headline: Price Waterhouse to invest $100 mln in China.

text.p: Price Waterhouse will invest $100 million in China in the next five years, aimed at recruitment and training of Chinese nationals, world chairman Dominic Tarantino said on Friday.
Company officials said Price Waterhouse now has about 600 people working in China and they expect to have 2,000 staff by 2000.
Officials said the $100 million was the largest single investment by Price Waterhouse worldwide.

Price Waterhouse also said it had reached an agreement with the state-owned commercial Bank of China to act as its financial adviser for a wide range of areas, including strategic planning, credit risk, market risk and liquidity risk management, information technology and internal controls.

The international auditing firm has also worked with the People's Bank of China, the central bank, over the past three years, assisting it in strengthening regulatory and accounting control in the financial sector, officials said.
